From: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwoodinference.com>

Subject: Security intake and vendor questionnaire initiation - Ecliptic Health

Hi Alex — thanks again for the call earlier today. Quick recap and proposed next steps from our side: 

What I heard (please correct me if I missed anything):
- Ecliptic Health will evaluate Redwood to support chart summarization and de-identification workflows in production.
- Primary concerns: SOC 2 Type II evidence, HIPAA coverage for PHI processing, and US-only data residency for test/production.
- You asked about starting vendor questionnaires (SIG/CAIQ) and whether we can prefill answers to accelerate review.

Clarifying questions we need to resolve before we route a prefilling pack:
1) SOC 2: Do you require an already-issued SOC 2 Type II report, or is a SOC 2 in-progress + controls mapping acceptable for procurement? If in-progress, please confirm target reporting period.
2) HIPAA: Will Redwood need a signed BAA to proceed with a technical review, or can we share technical evidence first and present the BAA during contracting?
3) Data residency: Confirm you need all customer data and logs to be restricted to us-east-1 (not just analytics).
4) Questionnaire type: Would you prefer (a) SIG Lite (faster, focused controls), (b) full SIG, or (c) CAIQ? We can prefill whichever you choose.
5) Owners: Who on your side will own evidence review and be the point of contact for attachments? Name + email helps us route evidence ownership internally.

Proposed next steps (we can adjust):
- If you want a prefilled SIG/CAIQ, reply with preferred form and the contact who will accept the prefill.
- We can deliver a SIG prefill + evidence bundle within 3 business days after we confirm the form and owners.
- Ben (cc'd) will own evidence collation from our side; Marissa will coordinate timeline and contract triggers.

Attaching: RDW_Security_Overview.pdf (high-level controls + SOC 2 status summary).

Thanks — happy to jump on a quick 20-min follow-up if that helps.

Best,
Tessa Morgan
Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference

Attachment: RDW_Security_Overview.pdf (summary, controls map, SOC 2 status)

From: Alex Green <alex.green@ecliptichealth.com>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 6 Mar 2028 09:38:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Security intake and vendor questionnaire initiation - Ecliptic Health

Thanks Tessa — great recap. A few quick answers: 

1) SOC 2: We require an issued SOC 2 Type II for any vendor in our production PHI pipeline. If Redwood has an in-progress Type II, we can accept the controls mapping temporarily but final contract approval will need the issued report (target date for our procurement sign-off: Q2 2028).
2) HIPAA / BAA: We need a signed BAA before any PHI is sent to a vendor environment. We can start technical evidence review before execution, but signing the BAA is a gating item for production testing.
3) Data residency: Yes — all customer data, including logs and backups, must remain in us-east-1. We will consider temporary exceptions for training/non-prod only with explicit approval.
4) Questionnaire type: SIG Lite is preferable for speed; if we need deeper assurance we can request a full SIG. For now, please send a SIG Lite prefill.
5) Owners: Please send prefill to security@ecliptichealth.com. Primary reviewer: Alex Green (alex.green@ecliptichealth.com).

I attached our internal intake form in case it helps (Ecliptic_Security_Intake_Form.xlsx).

Appreciate the quick turnaround — looking forward to the prefill.

—Alex
Alex Green
Director of Security Engineering
Ecliptic Health

Attachment: Ecliptic_Security_Intake_Form.xlsx (internal intake + procurement notes)
